dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare beneficiaries suffering from acute strokes, hospitals operating mobile stroke units, and ambulance providers.
dimensions.evidence: furnished by a mobile stroke unit... operated by a hospital for purposes of diagnosis, evaluation, or treatment

dimensions.assessment: Changes reimbursement terms and provides a specific payment increase for qualifying medical services.
dimensions.evidence: the amount of payment for such item or service otherwise determined under this subsection shall be increased by 5 percent.

dimensions.assessment: Alters Medicare payments and calculations under Title XVIII of the Social Security Act.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to ensure equitable payments for items and services furnished by mobile stroke units

dimensions.assessment: Amends specific statutory sections of the Social Security Act regarding outpatient hospital services and inpatient operating costs.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1833(t) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395l(t)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to Medicare payment rules taking effect on or after January 1, 2027.
dimensions.evidence: In the case of an item or service furnished on or after January 1, 2027

missing_information: Congressional Budget Office score detailing the exact total federal expenditure increase.
importance_detail.rationale: Modifies Medicare payment structures for hospital-operated mobile stroke units, including a 5 percent payment increase under certain rural or rendezvous models.
